sonnet.problem: The story card says one of them 'doesn't want to go down to the Jordan without Elisha.' That gives away the answer to the next choice card (card 6, 'To come along with them'). It also adds a reason for the request that the text doesn't give.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.

sonnet.problem: This true/false card re-asks the fact card 6 just asked, that one of the men asks Elisha to come with them. The only new part is whether Elisha refuses.
sonnet.rule: An easy follow-up asks something new. It never re-asks the same fact. Two lines that make the same point get one question.

sonnet.problem: The True statement mostly repeats story card 9, which already told that the axe head comes off while he is chopping.
sonnet.rule: A True statement never just repeats the card before it.

sonnet.problem: The 'Me? I'd...' joke shape repeats the one on card 3 ('Me? I'd show up dragging a twig...'). Both are Papa Dorin picturing himself doing the clumsy thing.
sonnet.rule: Each joke idea, comparison and punchline shape is used once per lesson.

sonnet.problem: 'Right there among the trees' adds a setting the text doesn't give. Verse 6 only says he cut a stick and threw it. The card also says Elisha 'doesn't go into the water,' which the text doesn't state.
sonnet.rule: No added settings. No setting the text doesn't give.
